title: Adam Was a Chinaman - DPLA - b3887b612a78b07778e04fe3a0463cfd
author: Bartholomew, Charles Lewis 'Bart', 1869-1949
description: The Russian Bear and Eve force a Chinese Adam to sign over part of Eden in 'the first real estate transfer'. The caption reads Prehistoric fragment from Chinese Temple, Discovered by Prof. Jas. E. Burton of Cornell, Showing that China's trouble began at an early date. Contemporary news accounts relate that Russia was attempting to take Manchuria from China.
